title: Philips 65PML9506/12 (TP Vision, board PH1M_EA_9970A, MediaTek), Spain
notes:
Philips 65PML9506/12 (TP Vision, board PH1M_EA_9970A, MediaTek), Spain
Android TV 11 (API 30), build RTT2.211108.001, 2.8 GB RAM, UI 1920x1080 at 320 dpi, Wi-Fi.
Fingerprint: Philips/PH1M_EA_9970A/PH1M_EA_9970A:11/RTT2.211108.001/21029:user/release-keys

Same board and firmware as examples/philips-50pus8517: its quirks apply (read them there), notably
do NOT disable org.droidtv.eum or org.droidtv.aurora (org.droidtv.xtv retries forever without them).
Apply:   TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/disable.sh examples/philips-65pml9506/debloat.txt
Undo:    TV_HOST=<tv ip> tools/restore.sh examples/philips-65pml9506/debloat.txt com.google.android.tvlauncher
Everything is DISABLED, not uninstalled. Comment out any line you want to keep.

Kept on purpose (owner's choice): Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+, Apple TV, Spotify, Stremio,
Moonlight, YouTube, voice assistant (katniss), Chromecast (mediashell), Alexa, ipcontrol and DLNA.
Left alone because their function could not be confirmed: com.phorus.playfi.*, dropboxprovider,
fastip, csm, sam, icp, cdasettings, org.droidtv.m7opapp.
Live TV app: org.droidtv.playtv
